objectives.statement: Recognize when a Norwegian adjective is used as a noun phrase.
Choose definite singular and plural forms such as den gamle and de unge.
Use neuter and indefinite patterns such as det viktigste and noe nytt.
Diagnose and build short sentences with adjectives used as nouns.

notes: Must teach nominalized adjectives with definiteness, number, and neuter/indefinite patterns. Keep examples concrete and avoid turning this into a full adjective-review lesson.
